why_in_two_sentences: Both competitors anchor the term properly in Jennifer Freyd's betrayal trauma theory, including the dependency insight (you may accept a betrayal from someone you rely on to stay safe), which our page never names. Ours is the better lived account: the guard tuned to catch the next one, the kindness that triggers suspicion, and especially why losing trust in your own judgment outlasts losing trust in the betrayer, with 33 FAQs including EMDR and phone-checking. (The #1 organic result, Freyd's own lab definition page, was skipped as a definition entry rather than an article, and #2, #4 were a PDF and Wikipedia; the next article results were judged.)
